description: Compute the RFC 7638 thumbprint of a single JWK: canonicalize its required members into lexicographically-ordered, whitespace-free JSON and hash it. A fingerprint for identifying/matching a key, not a signature or verification. Accepts a bare JWK only, not a JWKS set.

input.description: A single JWK object (not a JWKS set)

name: compute_jwk_thumbprint
